claims.claim: Direct Tokunbo Valeo Alternator for Mercedes-Benz M278 - 439741
claims.evidence: No clear 'Valeo' branding, Mercedes part number, or M278/439741 marking is readable in the provided photos.
Photos only show the alternator; no packaging, import markings, or provenance details are visible.

risks.risk: Wrong alternator fitment (different Mercedes application/voltage/current rating or different connector/clocking). Photos don’t show a readable part number to confirm compatibility.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the alternator label/engraving showing the Valeo part number and/or Mercedes OEM number (and the connector type).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: wrong/uncertain fitment (assume buyer may not be able to install without returns).

risks.risk: Electrical condition unknown (diode/regulator/brushless components may fail even if it looks intact).
risks.proof: Video of alternator being bench-tested or installed test: output voltage under load (e.g., multimeter reading at idle and with headlights/AC).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: not guaranteed working.

risks.risk: Pulley/shaft and bearings condition unknown (play/noise can exist even if exterior looks fine).
risks.proof: Clip showing the pulley/shaft spun by hand (and any wobble/play), plus a short sound check (bearing noise).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: may need bearing/pulley service.

risks.risk: Connector/terminal damage or missing parts (housing cracks, broken pins, or missing mounting hardware).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both electrical connector faces/terminals and all mounting ears/holes, taken straight-on and in focus.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: may require connector/terminal repair or missing hardware.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the alternator label/engraving with Valeo part number and/or Mercedes OEM number (must be readable).
Photo of the full alternator with the connector side clearly visible (straight-on) to confirm connector type.
Bench test or installed test results: voltage output readings (idle and with load) and any fault codes if installed.
Video showing pulley/shaft spin for bearing play/wobble and a quick sound check.
response.reason: The photos show an alternator, but the key identifiers (Valeo/Mercedes part number and the claimed M278/439741 reference) are not readable, so the correct fitment and working condition cannot be confirmed remotely. To price safely, we need the readable part number and a working test.
